construction_status: Land clearing begins.

Building 1 and 2 are operational. Based on Oracle [announcing](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/releasenotes/oci/new-region-batam.htm) the Indonesia North (Batam) region is available, and both buildings looking complete soon after, in June.
Building 3 shell is partly built. Building 1 and 2 look complete.
Building 3 has cooling towers beginning to be installed.
Building 3 looks complete including building shell, chillers and backup generators.

Building 3 is operational. Based on it looking complete as of March, and DayOne [posting](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dayonedc-datacenter-batam-ugcPost-7450899048925986816-Wxqu/) a video of the facility on this date. In one shot of the video, fan movement is visible for all buildings, suggesting they are all operational.
The three buildings look unchanged since March.

Land clearing begins for campus 1, seen via satellite imagery. This start date is corroborated by the [Malaysian Investment Development Authority](https://www.mida.gov.my/media-release/bridge-data-centres-and-bytedance-celebrate-grand-opening-of-the-first-phase-hyperscale-data-centre-my06-in-johor-malaysia/), citing November for officially first breaking ground.

Building 1 (MY06-1) is operational. The [SEC filing for Chindata](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1807192/000095017022025569/cd-ex99_1.htm) and [local news sources](https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/2022/10/21/mida-malaysia-still-most-desirable-location-for-data-centre-hubs-in-the-region/34929) reported the building was in service as of October 20, but only a [subsequent filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1807192/000095017023015950/cd-20221231.htm) confirmed 19 MW was utilized by December 31, so we conservatively assume December 31.

[Drone footage](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ozi5G1Lt4Ew) indicates that Building 1 is operating at full capacity, with 4 of 5 cooling tower fans spinning. Building 2 has 2 of 21 fans spinning and some ongoing construction work, so we assume it's not fully operational yet. We estimate another 3 months until full utilization.
Building 2 (MY06-2) is operational.

Building 3 and 4 are operational. Building 3 was [originally scheduled](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1807192/000119312523034103/d282677dex994.htm) for 2024Q4, and seemed partly operational in June, so it's likely to be fully utilized by this date. Building 4 was [scheduled](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1807192/000095017023045611/cd-ex99_1.htm) for delivery starting 2024Q1, but it typically takes a few more months to fit out and reach full utilization, so we think it's only fully utilized by this date. At Campus 2, Buildings 5-7 and Building 9 are close to finishing construction while Buildings 8 and 10 shells are still under construction. The Campus 2 substation looks complete.
Construction looks complete on Building 5, 6 and 7, but we allow 3 more months for fit-out and ramping before declaring them operational.
Buildings 5-7 are operational.
Buildings 8 and 9 look structurally complete. The remaining building, building 10, still has construction material around it and scaffolding on the roof, with cooling units yet to be installed.

All cooling units are now installed on Building 10. [Drone footage](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BVdGV8FFaLw) from the same month shows most cooling units operating for Buildings 5-7, but none (or very few) for Buildings 8-10. So we don't think Buildings 8-10 are operating significantly yet.
No visible construction work on Buildings 8-10, but no cars in their carparks either (whereas Building 7 has many cars). So we still don't think Buildings 8-10 are utilized.
Construction for Building 1-2 is underway.

Buildings 1-2 are fully operational. Based on DayOne [reporting](https://web.archive.org/web/20241231165420/https://dayonedc.com/) that 120 MW is in operation in Johor, with [50 MW](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/41886329/support-ai-computing-deployment-gds-holdings-nusajaya-technology-park-datacenter?level=1&data_ticket=1778269491837872) towards these two buildings. The date is based on the earliest available archived webpage, so this may have happened earlier.

Buildings 3-6 are operational, based on them looking complete. DayOne [reported](https://archive.is/8CFXN) that 390 MW is "in service" in Johor as of Jan 30. This is across both Nusajaya (including Phase 1, which we don't include here) and Kempas, but Nusajaya is the vast majority of capacity at this time. Building 7 and 8 look almost complete, while Building 9 and 10 shells are still under construction.
Buildings 7-10 look mostly complete, but there is still some construction work at the edges.
Buildings 7-10 are operational. Judging by their state in April 2026, we expect 3 months to finish construction and another 3 months to ramp to full capacity.
Land clearing begins.

In this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HODHjDbFt10) at 6:28, some fans can be seen in motion for Building 3. However, we think it's unlikely that any buildings are at fully operational capacity yet. Buildings 1-4 are roofed. Building 5-6 shells are underway.

Buildings 3 and 4 are operational. This is based on construction looking complete, and DayOne [reporting](https://archive.is/8CFXN) 390 MW "in service" across both Nusajaya and Kempas campuses as of Jan 30. Subtracting our [Nusajaya estimates](https://epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers/directory/dayone-nusajaya) (69.5 MW excluded in Phase 1 + 240.3 MW AI) implies ~80 MW in service at KTP, consistent with roughly 2 buildings per our ~49.6 MW per-building estimate, but not at full capacity. Buildings 1 and 2 look complete with rooftop cooling equipment installed (32 units each, in 2 strips of 16). The units are almost all single-fan cells; Building 2 has one strip of 16 single-fan cells and one darker bank of 16 long multi-fan air-cooled (slat) units - this suggests an cell-to-air-cooled power equivalence that informs our power estimates. The smaller Building 9 (west of Building 1, half fit-out: 16 cells) also has its cooling installed. Building 5 has rooftop equipment partially installed; Building 6 is roofed; Buildings 7-8 shells are still underway.

Buildings 1-4 and the smaller Building 9 assumed fully operational: cooling equipment was installed by Jan 2026 (Building 9 on the same timeline as Building 1) and the implied KTP in-service figure (~80 MW) shows them ramping in early 2026, so we allow ~3 more months to reach full capacity. Rooftop equipment texture is visible campus-wide.
Buildings 5-6 look complete and parking lot activity suggests they are nearly operational. Building 7-8 nearing completion with some construction equipment still in their vicinity.

Buildings 5-6 assumed operational. These buildings were roofed between Sep and Dec 2025 and equipment fit-out was underway in Jan 2026; applying the default roof-to-operational delay plus ramp time approximates their operability to this date.

Buildings 7-8 assumed operational. These buildings were roofed by March 2026 and by August 2026 their cooling and backup power equipment looked complete. With an additional two months of commissioning after August we approximate their operability to this date.
